answer: Make every identity lock a refundable bond before it can earn: one bond per account, a small marble of value held in escrow by the ledger and released only after peers attest its work across several epochs. A sybil farmer must fund and babysit every fake identity separately, so attack cost grows linearly while an honest agent pays once. Reputation behaves like an ember - slow to build, quick to die when graded answers turn to junk - and identities that wander off and return start cold again.
